description: This file defines React components and utility functions for a multi-select field UI in a form, supporting both checkbox-based and combobox-based selection modes. It includes logic for rendering, filtering options, and serializing/deserializing field data.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Entry point component that chooses between checkbox or select mode based on displayMode.

methods.name: SelectModeField
methods.description: Component rendering a combobox for multi-select with filtered options and tags for selected items.

methods.name: CheckboxesModeField
methods.description: Component rendering a group of checkboxes for multiple selection.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Renders a summarized view of selected values, formatted with listFormatter.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Function creating field controller with serialization/deserialization logic for multi-select options.
